title: Design System: True Custom Construction LLC

aliases: #fff hero H1, selected chip text, ghost hover stroke

display.purpose: Hero H1 only (phones); bounces in letter by letter.

display-wide.purpose: Hero H1 beside the photo card.

row.purpose: Service rows; Facebook row is clamp(19px,5.2vw,22px).

title.purpose: Step titles (22px from 1024px), wordmark; ready H3 at 24px.

label.purpose: Form labels and legends in the display face.

wordmark-sub.purpose: "Construction LLC" under the wordmark; the only uppercase.

card.purpose: Form card, ready panel, work figures, hero photo card.

circle.purpose: Arrow circles, step numbers, eyebrow dot, float circle.

shadows.name: row-lift
shadows.purpose: The white Facebook row on paper.

shadows.name: float-lift
shadows.purpose: The floating message circle over every band.

textures.name: band-lines
textures.purpose: Deep-slate bands, footer and the hero band; about 4% white or fainter.

textures.name: hero-overlay
textures.purpose: Ink overlay on the hero photo below 760px only.

motion.name: letter-in
motion.purpose: Hero H1 bounce-in only; gated on Cal Sans load (max 800ms) with .hold released by 1.6s timeout.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Fade-up for .rise elements that start below the first screen.

motion.name: float-in
motion.purpose: Floating message circle entering after the hero.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all of the above off; plain H1, no hold, no smooth scroll

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Crew's Own Yard"**

The site is the crew's own world laid out in calm, full-bleed bands: off-white paper, the slate navy and deep slate of the dark board-and-batten house on their Facebook profile, and one warm yellow taken from the Cat 279D loader in their job video. It is Ellie's calm band style (after lpmr.co.uk) applied to a grading-and-remodel crew. Bands alternate light and dark so each section begins plainly, and the only photograph that leads is their own machine on a yard they graded.

Density is low and phone-first. Each band holds one heading, one short idea, and at most one action group. Shapes are soft and borderless: 24px cards, full pills, tinted fields with no stroke. Depth comes from the bands and from tint, not from shadow; only two things lift off the page, the Facebook row and the floating message circle.

Motion is limited to three moves. The hero H1 bounces in letter by letter. Everything that starts below the first screen fades up 12px. The message circle slides in once the hero has gone. All three switch off under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Paper, two slate navies, one yellow. The ground is never black.
Yellow is a fill. When yellow has to be text on a light ground it becomes Yellow Ink.
One display face (Cal Sans, weight 400) for every heading, row, label and button. Body text is the system stack at 16/1.7.
Soft, borderless forms: 24px cards, 999px pills, 10px tinted fields, 50% circles.
On the service rows and the Facebook row, only the arrow circle reacts to hover.

rules.name: The Fill-Only Yellow Rule
rules.body: Yellow is never text on a light ground. Use it for fills and for accents on navy or deep slate; on paper or white the same role uses Yellow Ink.

rules.name: The Two Focus Colours Rule
rules.body: Focus rings are Field Blue on light grounds and Yellow on navy, deep slate, the hero and the footer. Form controls inside the navy band are back on a white card, so they use Field Blue.

rules.name: The Never-Black Rule
rules.body: The darkest ground is Deep Slate. No band, overlay or panel goes to black.

rules.name: The One Display Face Rule
rules.body: Every heading, row, label, button, step number and phone number is Cal Sans 400. Nothing is set bolder than 400 in the display face, and there is no second webfont.

rules.name: The Sixteen-Floor Rule
rules.body: Inputs, textareas and chips are 16px or larger so iOS never zooms on focus.

rules.name: The Flat Bands Rule
rules.body: Cards, figures, form controls and buttons carry no shadow. A new surface separates itself by band or tint, not by lift.

dos: **Do** keep the band rhythm: paper, then navy or deep slate, then paper. The deep bands and the hero carry the 135° line texture at 3.5% white.
**Do** put text on yellow in Slate Ink, and switch yellow-as-text on light grounds to Yellow Ink.
**Do** set every heading, row, label and button in Cal Sans 400, and body text in the system stack at 16/1.7.
**Do** use the radii: 24px cards, 20px Facebook row, 10px fields, 999px pills, 50% circles.
**Do** give form controls Field Tint on the white card and a Field Blue border on hover and focus.
**Do** let only the arrow circle react on link rows.
**Do** gate hover styles behind `(hover:hover)` so taps never leave them stuck on.
**Do** keep tap targets at least 44px (buttons 56px, chips 48px, fields 52px).
donts: **Don't** use yellow as text on paper or white, or white text on yellow.
**Don't** go to a black ground; Deep Slate is the floor.
**Don't** add shadows to cards, figures, fields or buttons. The Facebook row and the floating circle are the only lifted things.
**Don't** add a second webfont or set Cal Sans above 400.
**Don't** animate any heading other than the hero H1. Don't hide content at rest; only below-the-fold elements wait for the fade-up.
**Don't** stretch a photo or blow the tall hero frame across a wide band; from 760px it is a card beside the copy.
**Don't** add a bottom contact bar; the floating message circle is the only fixed control.
**Don't** put eyebrows on every heading, give them hover or arrows, or fill them with full yellow.
